name: Aquatic Plants and Algae Detection (APA)
description: Detects and visualizes aquatic plants and algae in water bodies from Sentinel-2 L2A reflectance using spectral indices (FAI, water-plants, NDWI, moisture) with Braaten-Cohen-Yang cloud masking. Based on the APA script by the University of Girona. Adapted from a SentinelHub Custom Script by Anna Peliova, Carla Garcia-Lozano, Josep Sitjar.
